Priya: Heads up — day-of panel ops: 3 panels back-to-back 1pm-3pm. Need livestream link, scribe coverage for panel B, and someone to own debrief capture. Also a quick ping for code review of the interviewer guide before 12:30. Can folks confirm?
Samir Patel: I can take scribe for panel B (2:00-2:30) if no one else. cc @Elena K. for livestream?
Elena K.: I can create livestream link and set recording permissions. Which meeting ID are we using?
Priya: Using Zoom ID 987654321. Please enable transcript and make it viewable to interviewers only. Debrief owner: @Aisha?
Aisha: Happy to own debrief capture. I'll post the debrief doc and template. Anyone have rubric tweaks before I lock it?
Samir Patel: Small tweak: add 'system design clarifies constraints' as separate check. Otherwise LGTM.
Priya: :thumbsup: Samir — please update the rubric section and ping when done.
DevEx Bot: calendar-bot: Event updated: 'Backend Panel - Day of' 2024-08-24 13:00-15:00. Guests notified.
Elena K.: Livestream link created: https://zoom.us/j/987654321?pwd=abc123 — recording/transcript ON. Scribe invites sent to @Samir Patel and @Maya.
Maya: I got the invite — can cover panel A instead (1:00-1:30). Samir, still good to swap to B?
Samir Patel: Yep swapping with @Maya is fine.
Priya: Code review ping: @Samir Patel, @Elena K. — interviewer guide PR `#512`. Quick look for clarity and timing notes? Need approvals by 12:30.
Elena K.: I'll skim now, leave inline comments. Noted on timing.
Samir Patel: Will review now. A few nits on phrasing; won't block.
Aisha: Debrief doc link: https://docs.redwood.com/debriefs/dayof-backend-panels — template filled. I'll lock after signatures.
Maya: Note: candidate needs accommodation for captioning — already flagged; Zoom transcript ok?
Priya: Yes transcript is fine. Add caption request to the debrief notes.
Priya: Thanks all — will follow up in thread if anything changes. :pray:
